title: Subthalamic local field potentials during the balloon analogue risk task (Pearson et al., 2017): Parkinson's disease DBS surgery (derivative: decimated LFP)
description: Intraoperative subthalamic nucleus (STN) local field potential recordings from 14 patients with Parkinson's disease undergoing deep brain stimulation implantation, collected while they performed a self-paced balloon analogue risk task. Recordings used single microelectrodes and, in a subset of sessions, a 32-channel microwire array. This derivative release repackages the 200 Hz decimated LFP and behavioural data from the original Dryad deposit into BIDS iEEG format, with artifact-censoring intervals stored in the events files.
methods_description: LFP was recorded intraoperatively with a Plexon MAP system and FHC Guideline 4000 at 1 kHz and stored decimated at 200 Hz (250 Hz in four recordings). Single tungsten microelectrodes were used for STN localisation, and in seven datasets a 32-channel Pt/Ir microwire array was advanced into the STN. Spikes were sorted offline with WaveClus. Behavioural data from the balloon analogue risk task and artifact-censoring intervals are provided in events.tsv.
